headers: Section: Attribute 5 Product Specifications: Can UMN provide the desired data classification and storage-tiering strategy (e.g., Hot, Cool, Cold, Archive), including the percentage of data expected in each tier and the corresponding retrieval SLA/acceptable retrieval time for each classification? Please clarify whether archive-tier rehydration delays are acceptable for any portion of the dataset.
sample: Section: Attribute 8 (cloud/hybrid): The RFP references possible network connectivity and/or API waivers. Will UMN sponsor or facilitate an egress/API-cost waiver via Internet2/R&E peering with the cloud provider?
Yes. Any additional waiver ideas would be welcome as well.
Section: Attribute 8 For all solutions: Which component or application is responsible for compressing and transferring data from Qumulo to the BlackPearl archival platform?
Section: Attribute 8 For all solutions: Does BlackPearl support and manage dual-copy tape retention and replication policies for archival data protection?
